title: 第18章 府城寻蚁
novel_title: 御兽仙朝：我能设计进化形态
content_zh:
第二天，天蒙蒙亮。

    潜鳞书院的晨雾还没有散尽的时候，金教习就起来了。

    院子里，被他养了十几年的灰褐色大蜥蜴，听到动静之后，懒洋洋地撑开了眼睛，喉咙里发出一声闷响。

    肩头的【百问鹦】还炸着羽毛，在半梦半醒之间喃喃道着一些难以辨认的话。

    大铁、溜子以及那只到现在都没有给它取一个名字的【灰鬃鼠】都缩在了一起取暖。

    今天，是七号学堂开设《御兽进化论》课程的日子。

    这节课金老师讲了不知多少遍了。

    将【进化石】放到讲台上，放出里面的能量，使得屋里天赋最高的一或二只蚂蚁在众人面前进化。

    让这些刚入门的崽子们亲眼看看什么是进化的天威。

    每年都会有这种模式。

    金教习刚要伸手，去拍那大蜥蜴的脊背，眼角的余光，却瞥见院门那处，不知何时，立了一个人。

    身着洗得发白的墨青教习袍，背部微微凹陷。

    是冯教习。

    金教习略微一愣。

    按照时间来判断，冯教习应该是去【兽储堂】那边。

    “老冯？”

    他拱拱手，带着些许不解地说：

    “你怎么来了。”

    冯教习没有马上回答，只是慢慢的走到面前，淡淡的说道：

    “今天这门课程，我跟你一起去。”

    金教习的眉毛轻轻向上挑了挑。

    他和冯教习是相识了有几十年的老人了。

    可这位老人的身份，和他到底是不同的。

    冯教习负责潜鳞书院的【初契堂】与【兽储库】，是一个十分重要的副院长。

    书院除去了叶院长，就数他位分最高了。

    一位副院长亲自来到这里观看一场很普通的开课礼？

    金教习斟酌了一下：

    “老冯，你身为执掌【初契堂】与【兽储库】的副院，竟肯亲自来观这一场礼？”

    他停顿了一下，接着道：

    “这种事情，交给那些已经被【兽储库】派往学堂的学生们去做，把蚁变记录下来，不就成了吗？”

    冯教习走到他的身边之后就停了下来。

    那张脸上没有什么表情。

    “老金，你不知道。”

    他压低了声音：

    “上头……传下消息来了。”

    金教习的脸色正了正。

    “消息？”

    冯教习点点头，枯瘦的手背在身后。

    “府城那一位大人……给院长，送了话。”

    府城。
content_en:
The next day, it was dark.

Before the morning fog in Qianlin Academy had cleared, Professor Jin got up.

In the yard, the large gray-brown lizard he had raised for more than ten years opened its eyes lazily after hearing the movement, and made a muffled sound in its throat.

The [Hundred Question Parrot] on the shoulder was still blowing its feathers, muttering some indecipherable words while half asleep.

Datie, Liuzi, and the [gray-maned rat] who had not yet given it a name all huddled together to keep warm.

Today is the day when School No. 7 opens the course "Evolution of Beast Control".

Teacher Jin has taught this class countless times.

Place the [Evolution Stone] on the podium and release the energy inside, causing one or two of the most talented ants in the room to evolve in front of everyone.

Let these newbies see with their own eyes what the power of evolution is.

This pattern happens every year.

Just as Jin Jiaoxi was about to reach out and pat the big lizard's back, out of the corner of his eye, he caught a glimpse of a person standing at the courtyard gate.

Wearing a white-washed black-green teaching robe, his back is slightly sunken.

It’s Professor Feng.

Professor Jin was slightly stunned.

Judging by the time, Professor Feng should have gone to the [Beast Storage Hall].

"Old Feng?"

He cupped his hands and said with some confusion:

"Why are you here?"

Teacher Feng did not answer immediately, but slowly walked up to him and said calmly:

"I will go with you for today's course."

Professor Jin’s eyebrows raised slightly.

He and Professor Feng have known each other for decades.

But the identity of this old man is different from him.

Feng Jiaoxi is responsible for Qianlin Academy's [Chu Qitang] and [Beast Reserve], and is a very important vice president.

Except for Dean Ye, he has the highest position in the academy.

A vice-dean came here in person to watch a very ordinary opening ceremony?

Jin Jiaoxi thought about it:

"Old Feng, as the vice-president in charge of [Chu Qitang] and [Beast Reserve], you are actually willing to come and watch this ceremony in person?"

He paused and then said:

"Isn't it enough to leave this kind of thing to the students who have been sent to the school by [Beast Reserve] to record the ant changes?"

Teacher Feng stopped after walking to his side.

There was no expression on that face.

"Lao Jin, you don't know."

He lowered his voice:

"The superiors... have sent word."

Jin Jiaoxi’s face straightened.

"News?"

Teacher Feng nodded, his skinny hands behind his back.

"The gentleman in Fucheng... sent a message to the dean."

Fucheng.
title_en: Chapter 18 Looking for Ants in Fucheng
